commands.fingerprint_scope: Root 2.0 src, examples/vite, tests, tools, README, LICENSE, package/lock and TS/Vitest configuration. Recursive inventory excludes every nested node_modules directory. No installed/cache file is a source input. Installed dependencies/browser binaries are identified by lock/runtime/consumer records; preserved v1 benchmark inputs stay unchanged.
commands.note: Only the latest sixteen passing records certify these frozen inputs. Earlier command records and byte-exact logs are retained separately. The inspected compiler artifact is the exact tarball installed in JS/TS and all five browser consumers.

development_evidence.note: Development reproduction logs and the receipt retain their own inputs and failures. They do not certify frozen final inputs or reproduce unavailable interim source bytes.

checks.example_types: pass; Node Vite config/mock server excluded
checks.installed_geometry: Frozen logical row scopes, immutable prior IDs, centered reveal between authored sticky bands, accessible height keyboard controls, exact teardown and quiet late events, alongside preceding CVC/control/block/lifecycle/viewport assertions.

blocks.merge: Adjacent scalar group keys span complete two-row records; each native merge stays inside a consecutive mounted segment.

method.timing: Rows and authored HTML prepared outside timing. Each operation includes two successive stable animation-frame geometry observations; fail after fifteen frames.
method.focus: One invalid draft editor remains pinned with its exact node and caret while a distant variable-height window renders.
method.paste: Flat/nested paste one thousand offscreen records; blocks paste one hundred. Each changes two fields in one atomic event; nested detail uses numeric Select values.
method.move: Move the last of five thousand stored rows before a stable row near the current window; one event, unchanged snapshot and pinned draft/caret. Includes settled DOM with a 100ms same-host Chromium median budget.

append.operation: After original operations and twenty scroll-cycle assertions, append 250 clean records in one event. Preserve every old snapshot/order, save changes, checks, focused node/draft/caret and scroll anchor. Dispose all 5,250 records under the original cleanup budget.

method.geometry: Every live checkpoint requires intersecting mounted data rows and different measured row heights; reveal verifies the complete requested record rectangle and forward scroll advances logical intersection. Blocks record native physical-row heights, record bounds and merge spans; twenty cycle windows record actual intersections.
method.cleanup: Exact authored markup/style after disposal, then observe zero mutations across late scroll and stable frames; this observes quiet work, not a direct cancelAnimationFrame call.
method.memory: Chromium CDP forces GC before DOM counters; twenty-cycle growth remains bounded by two viewport element counts and twenty listeners. After detaching the fixture, record native focus/selection retention, release it by focusing the existing external main and clearing document ranges, wait two frames, then require the stated pre-fixture cleanup budget. No JavaScript heap-retention claim.
method.budgets: Host-relative Chromium medians declared before measurement; other engines report samples without applying Chromium thresholds.

performance.limits: Same-host completed DOM operations in Chromium; no universal speed, actual token or JavaScript heap-retention claim. Original fixture sizes, operations, warmups, samples and budgets remain unchanged; append adds 250 clean records last and teardown covers 5,250.

review.baseline: Independent read-only audit matched b9d2956: all 158 preceding source/configuration fingerprints, both preserved metadata files, 33 raw logs, sixteen final gates and every actual member of the exact 173-file preceding archive. No historical runtime rerun or recertification.
review.source: Independent plan and connected Grid/height/viewport/Form/Popup/CVC/detail review, plus independently authored identity/lifetime acceptance cases. Authored detail navigation uses existing owners rather than a new framework runtime.

Retain reveal alignment through remount measurement rather than stopping at a previously cached height.
Make an unmeasurable root handle inert until usable geometry returns, restoring only framework-owned inert state without a fabricated height.

Cancel a stranded mouse gesture when its primary-button bit is absent; retain ordinary pointerup commit. Native test coordinates stay inside the browser viewport without weakening the exact movement/result assertions.
Preserve the existing pre-row-hook rollback and post-row-hook committed-view boundaries; use the existing GRID_DISPOSED code.
review.contracts: Visible/filtered row scopes retain explicitly shown tombstones, while store scope stays live Map order. Native nonvirtual alignment uses authored scroll-padding/margins. Min/max constrain owned height operations; external authored dimensions are announced honestly. Legacy option/default/dynamic closure and other component/CVC parity stay required; M13 remains future whole-code review/remediation. No omission or full parity approval.

limits: Only the contracted M10.9.5 slice is completed; M10.9.6 semantic closure, remaining framework parity, P0 dynamic/option closure and M13 remain required.
Actual macOS/iOS Safari is excluded; manual assistive technology, OS IME/clipboard, personal acceptance and fixed final agent-task/token evaluation remain unverified.
